text: In 1907 Dr. Paul Eswai arrives in the village of Karmingam to autopsy a woman found dead in an abandoned church, and finds a silver coin buried in her heart. The villagers say [the ghost of a little girl|threat|the restless dead] curses anyone she visits, and the witch Ruth [plants coins in the hearts of the dead|rules|faith and charms protect] to hold her back. With the medical student Monica, Eswai follows the trail to the decaying Villa Graps, where a Baroness mourns [a daughter trampled to death at a festival|wrong|harm done to children] and the hallways repeat endlessly.
